description: The line plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words between generated training samples (K=32) across 64 relation categories, with the x-axis representing the relation category from 0 to 64 and the y-axis showing the average repetition rate ranging from 0.0 to 0.6. The plot compares three different configurations: "w/o DPO obo" (blue solid line), "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" (orange solid line), and "DPO" (green solid line), along with their respective average values represented by dashed lines. The "w/o DPO obo" configuration shows a high initial repetition rate around 0.6 at category 0, followed by a sharp decline and fluctuating behavior, with notable peaks near categories 23 and 32. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" configuration exhibits a more consistent pattern with significant peaks around categories 32 and 47, reaching up to 0.6, and generally higher repetition rates than the DPO method. The DPO method (green line) maintains a relatively low and stable repetition rate, mostly below 0.2, with minor fluctuations. The average repetition rates for each configuration are indicated by horizontal dashed lines: 0.227 for "w/o DPO obo", 0.163 for "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", and 0.117 for DPO, highlighting the effectiveness of DPO in reducing repetition.
